scope: Procurement-reference acceptance hardening: HR18 sync observability, immutable manual retry, and executable 3s/5s/100-concurrency QA probe

referenceUse.document: User-provided 9-page non-degree education smart-front procurement checklist
referenceUse.policy: Acceptance-quality reference only; HR01-HR18 domain boundaries remain authoritative
adoptedPatterns: field mapping and last sync/failure observability
single/batch manual retry with original failure evidence retained

fixedDefects: HR18 target mappings and sync health were not visible together for operator verification
terminal exchange failures had automatic dead-lettering but no controlled single/batch manual requeue path
manual retry must append a successor instead of resetting or erasing the original failed job/attempt evidence
preserved historical failures and currently unresolved failures needed separate counters
receipt-required targets must not report transport-only success as end-to-end success
manual retry idempotency must reject changed job number/reason/max-attempt parameters under the same key
reconciliation dead letters needed an observable unresolved reason even when job.last_error_code is blank
procurement 3s/5s and 100-concurrency targets were prose only rather than an executable QA gate
class-scoped static checks now prevent retry fields placed on the wrong job model from passing source gates

exchangeContract.originalFailurePolicy: source job, attempts and dead-letter facts remain intact

runtimeGatesStillRequiredBeforeTraffic: MySQL migrate 0019 on disposable QA database and migration-state drift check
two-admin concurrent manual retry of the same dead-letter
provider failure -> dead-letter -> manual retry -> receipt -> reconciliation end-to-end
authenticated browser HR18 exchange workbench flow
desensitized realistic-data performance run: normal <=3s, analytics <=5s, 100 concurrent
real school SSO/data-middle-platform/provincial interface integration only after official specs are available

packageVerification.manifestPolicy: ROUND10_FILE_MANIFEST.tsv covers every packaged file except itself
